summaries.summary: The page describes a collaboration example between Diabetes UK, Garfield Weston Foundation, and Nonsense to create an online resource for young people with Type 1 diabetes, called #Type1Uncut. It includes logos, a photo of the team, and a video thumbnail. The Diabetes UK logo is shown with the text 'CARE. CONNECT. CAMPAIGN.' below it.
key_facts: Diabetes UK's slogan is 'CARE. CONNECT. CAMPAIGN.'
The collaboration involved Diabetes UK, Garfield Weston Foundation, and Nonsense to create #Type1Uncut.
The project includes workshops with young people and YouTube videos on topics they care about.
